_seo.descrizione: Long-term rentals with LA MAISON GROUP: tenant search and screening, contract, registration and lease management. Request a quote.

intestazione.titolo_1: Rent out your property *with peace of mind*
intestazione.testo_1: We find the right tenant, draw up the contract and look after the lease over time.

il_servizio.testo_1: A long-term rental is the basis of a secure income, as long as the tenant is chosen well. We find them, check their reliability and take care of every step of the contract.
il_servizio.foto_1_alt: Cosy living room of an apartment for long-term rent

cosa_facciamo.testo_1: Well-crafted listings on the main portals, with photos and descriptions that attract the right candidates.
cosa_facciamo.testo_2: We check the references, income and reliability of every candidate before introducing them to you.
cosa_facciamo.testo_3: We choose the most suitable contract with you and take care of its registration.

come_funziona.testo_1: Tell us about your property by phone, on WhatsApp or by filling in the form.
come_funziona.testo_2: We visit the property and tell you the right rent for the local market.
come_funziona.testo_3: We publish the listing, organise viewings and only introduce you to screened candidates.
come_funziona.testo_4: We sign the contract and support you for the whole duration of the lease.

invito_finale.testo_1: Request a free rent valuation: we will tell you how much you can get and how we can help.
